name: Jev triage
description: Requires the Jev plugin (bronos.jev). The "triage" plugin service for source plugins (mail, Jira, chat): a priority (urgent, action, fyi, noise) and a kind per item, judged by Jev, with per-project rules, a profile of what you own, your corrections, and an improve loop that turns a wrong verdict into a better rule or profile in a Claude tab.
author: BronOS
